note: The conversion guide: how records are converted to one UDM table, as text for a model to follow, served by udm_guide and as a prompt. Same shape as AI4RA/prompt-library's component_catalog.json.

components.name: udm-conversion-guide
components.summary: How records are converted to one UDM table: look at the data, say what one row is, fetch the table, decide each column's operation (rename, split, combine, transform, recode, default, derive, resolve, route, generate, drop), conform values, fill provenance, ask once, report; one output row per source row.
